newsitem.title: UK: UK's ITV attacks EU Media concentration directive.
newsitem.headline: UK's ITV attacks EU Media concentration directive.

text.p: Britain's commercial television (ITV) network urged the European Commission on Wednesday to reject a proposed directive on media concentration.

"The current proposals are very damaging," said Barry Cox, Director of the ITV Network. "If the Commissioners agree them as currently drafted, they will pose a serious threat to the future of regional broadcasting in the UK and could stifle investment in digital terrestrial television," he added.

The Commission is due to discuss the proposals on Wednesday. They set a limit of 30 percent on the broadcast audience share a company could have in its area of reception and a limit of 10 percent on the audience share for multi-media firms.

Cox said that planned exemptions were an inadequate solution. "We hope that the Commission will take note of the concerns of the media companies it seeks to regulate and postpone agreement on the proposals until these concerns have been adequately addressed," he added.
